# GTP-U (`gtpu`)

- **Layer**: L4 (transport)
- **Header**: 8 octets (fixed)
- **Notes**: [Encapsulation and tunnels](../../protocols/encap.md)

## Reached from

| Lower layer | Selector | Value |
|---|---|---|
| [`udp`](udp.md) | `dst_port` / `src_port` | 2152 (0x0868) |

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Auto | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `version` | `uint(3)` | `1` |   | GTP version (1). |
| `protocol_type` | `uint(1)` | `1` |   | Protocol type (1 = GTP, 0 = GTP'). |

| `length` | `uint(16)` |   | Length of the payload in octets | Length of the payload after the mandatory header, in octets (Auto). |
| `teid` | `uint(32)` | `0` |   | Tunnel Endpoint Identifier. |

### `message_type`

| Value | Name |
|---|---|
| 1 (0x01) | `echo_request` |
| 2 (0x02) | `echo_response` |
| 26 (0x1a) | `error_indication` |
| 31 (0x1f) | `supported_extension_headers` |
| 254 (0xfe) | `end_marker` |
| 255 (0xff) | `g_pdu` |

## Next layer

The next layer is selected by `message_type`; when the field is Auto the builder writes the value of the protocol stacked above.

First 4 bits of the payload when `message_type` = 255 (0xff)

| Value | Protocol |
|---|---|
| 4 | [`ipv4`](ipv4.md) |
| 6 | [`ipv6`](ipv6.md) |
